verdict.rationale: Blocking resources is a fair axis for a browser-based crawler like Crawl4AI, but nothing in the evidence pack documents blocking images or CSS, by default or on request. The only related item is generic 'Advanced Browser Control: Hooks' (crawl4ai-docs-6). That is a developer building block, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block images and CSS resources by default to reduce bandwidth and speed up requests
